caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know your smartphone chip has more tiny switches than people in many countries? 🤯

💡 Every single action on your smartphone, from tapping an icon to watching a video, is controlled by billions of tiny electronic 'switches' called transistors.
